main_body: Wall bookshelf/scroll shelf with a tan wood frame, three dark-maroon shelf bays holding scrolls, books and small items, and a dark grey base
top_band: Light tan band at rows 1-3 (row 0 is a darker orange outline), ending in a mid-orange edge row at about row 4
evidence: Reading down the middle column: a light tan top band of about 3-4 rows, a distinct orange edge row, then the dark maroon bay directly under it, which reads as the top's shadow. The front face then has three bays inset behind wood uprights and 2-row shelf boards. The top band is thin and the shelf boards are drawn face-on, so it is borderline, but a top band of several rows, a front edge and an inset front are all present. This is not a hat on a flat face.

style.evidence: The wood uses about 3-4 tones (light tan, orange, mid brown, dark) with no grain or speckle. The frame uprights, shelf boards and top band are flat fills. The bay backs are large single-colour maroon areas well over 5x5 pixels. The small items (scrolls, books, cloth) are shaded decently, but the main body is thinner and flatter than the Beodeul stall and well, which have per-plank grain and several tones per material. Outlines lean toward the material tone, so they are not near-black.
